description: This file defines the PHP class 'bsd_common' which provides methods for retrieving system information on BSD operating systems, such as kernel version, hostname, IP address, hardware details, and hardware components by parsing system logs and executing system commands.

classes.name: bsd_common
classes.description: A PHP class that encapsulates methods for gathering BSD system information, including hardware details, system uptime, network configuration, and device information.

methods.name: bsd_common
methods.description: Constructor method initializing the Parser object.

methods.name: read_dmesg
methods.description: Reads the dmesg boot log, if not already read, and returns its contents.

methods.name: grab_key
methods.description: Retrieves a system value using sysctl with the specified key.

methods.name: hostname
methods.description: Returns the server name from environment variable or 'N.A.' if not set.

methods.name: chostname
methods.description: Returns the canonical hostname using the hostname command.

methods.name: ip_addr
methods.description: Returns the server's IP address, either from environment or via DNS resolution.

methods.name: kernel
methods.description: Extracts and returns the kernel version string.

methods.name: uptime
methods.description: Returns system uptime based on system ticks.

methods.name: users
methods.description: Returns the number of users currently logged in.

methods.name: loadavg
methods.description: Retrieves load average and optionally CPU load percentage.

methods.name: cpu_info
methods.description: Gathers CPU model and speed information, and CPU count.

methods.name: scsi
methods.description: Provides information about connected SCSI devices by parsing dmesg.

methods.name: pci
methods.description: Gathers PCI device information from parsing dmesg or using parser methods.

methods.name: ide
methods.description: Provides info on IDE devices from dmesg logs.

methods.name: usb
methods.description: Placeholder for USB detection, currently returns empty array.

methods.name: sbus
methods.description: Placeholder for SBus info, currently returns array with empty string.

methods.name: memory
methods.description: Retrieves system memory info, including total, free, used, and swap details.

methods.name: distro
methods.description: Returns the operating system distribution name via uname.
